easy.S1:
SELECT [Entity]
FROM [Table]
ORDER BY [Measure] DESC
LIMIT 5;
easy.S2:
SELECT [Entity]
FROM [Table]
GROUP BY [Entity]
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT [Category]) > 1;
easy.S3:
SELECT Category, Entity
FROM (
SELECT Category, Entity, Measure,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY Measure DESC) AS rn
 FROM Table
) t
WHERE rn = 1;
easy.S8:
SELECT Category, Entity
FROM (
 SELECT Category, Entity, Time,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY Time DESC) AS rn
 FROM Table
) t
WHERE rn = 1;
easy.S9: WITH sorted_values AS ( SELECT Category, Measure FROM YourTable ORDER BY Category, Measure ), category_arrays AS ( SELECT Category, JSON_ARRAYAGG(Measure) AS values_array, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sorted_values GROUP BY Category ), category_percentiles AS ( SELECT Category, IF( ABS((cnt-1)*0.3 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3)) < 1e-9, JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3), ']')), JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3), ']')) * (1 - ((cnt-1)*0.3 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3))) + JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', CEIL((cnt-1)*0.3), ']')) * (((cnt-1)*0.3 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3))) ) AS p30, IF( ABS((cnt-1)*0.7 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7)) < 1e-9, JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7), ']')), JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7), ']')) * (1 - ((cnt-1)*0.7 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7))) + JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', CEIL((cnt-1)*0.7), ']')) * (((cnt-1)*0.7 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7))) ) AS p70 FROM category_arrays ) SELECT t.Category, t.Entity, t.Measure, OtherColumns FROM YourTable t JOIN category_percentiles cp ON t.Category = cp.Category WHERE t.Measure BETWEEN cp.p30 AND cp.p70;
easy.S10:
WITH yearly_records AS (
SELECT DISTINCT Category, Entity, Time
FROM Table
WHERE Time IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
SELECT Category, Entity, Time,
   LAG(Time) OVER (PARTITION BY Category, Entity ORDER BY Time) AS prev_time
FROM yearly_records
)
SELECT DISTINCT Category, Entity
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Time) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM prev_time) = 1;
easy.S11:
WITH base AS (
SELECT 
Entity,
Time,
Measure,
LAG(Measure, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY Entity ORDER BY Time) AS prev1,
LAG(Measure, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY Entity ORDER BY Time) AS prev2
FROM Table
WHERE Time IS NOT NULL AND Measure IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT Entity
FROM base
WHERE prev2 IS NOT NULL
  AND Measure > prev1 AND prev1 > prev2;
easy.S12:
WITH ranked AS (
SELECT 
Category,
Entity,
Measure,
NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY Measure DESC) AS quintile
FROM Table
WHERE Measure IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Category, Entity
FROM ranked
WHERE quintile = 1;
easy.S13:
WITH category_stats AS (
SELECT 
Category,
AVG(Measure) AS avg_measure,
SUM(Measure) AS total_measure
FROM Table
GROUP BY Category
),
ranked AS (
SELECT 
t.Category,
t.Entity,
t.Measure,
cs.avg_measure,
cs.total_measure,
t.Measure / cs.total_measure * 100 AS pct_of_total,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.Category ORDER BY t.Measure / cs.total_measure DESC) AS rn
FROM Table t
JOIN category_stats cs ON t.Category = cs.Category
WHERE t.Measure > cs.avg_measure
)
SELECT Category, Entity, pct_of_total
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
easy.S14: WITH sorted_values AS ( SELECT category_column, measure_column FROM source_table ORDER BY category_column, measure_column ), category_arrays AS ( SELECT category_column, JSON_ARRAYAGG(measure_column) AS values_array, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sorted_values GROUP BY category_column ), category_median AS ( SELECT category_column, CASE WHEN (cnt-1)*0.5 = FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.5) THEN JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.5), ']')) ELSE JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.5), ']')) * (1 - ((cnt-1)*0.5 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.5))) + JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', CEIL((cnt-1)*0.5), ']')) * ((cnt-1)*0.5 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.5)) END AS median_value FROM category_arrays ) SELECT t.category_column, t.entity_column, t.measure_column, t.other_columns FROM source_table t JOIN category_median m ON t.category_column = m.category_column WHERE t.measure_column > m.median_value [AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM related_table r WHERE r.foreign_key = t.primary_key)];
easy.S15:
WITH category_avg AS (
SELECT Category, AVG(Measure) AS avg_measure
FROM Table
GROUP BY Category
),
ranked AS (
SELECT 
t.Category,
t.Entity,
t.Measure,
ca.avg_measure,
(t.Measure - ca.avg_measure) / ca.avg_measure * 100 AS pct_above_avg,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.Category ORDER BY t.Measure DESC) AS rn
FROM Table t
JOIN category_avg ca ON t.Category = ca.Category
WHERE t.Measure IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Category, Entity, Measure, avg_measure, pct_above_avg
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3;
easy.S16:
WITH lagged AS (
SELECT 
Category,
Entity,
Time,
Measure,
LAG(Measure) OVER (PARTITION BY Category, Entity ORDER BY Time) AS prev_measure
FROM Table
WHERE Measure IS NOT NULL AND Time IS NOT NULL
),
growth AS (
SELECT 
Category,
Entity,
Time,
(Measure - prev_measure) / NULLIF(prev_measure, 0) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM lagged
WHERE prev_measure IS NOT NULL AND prev_measure > 0
),
ranked AS (
SELECT 
Category,
Entity,
growth_rate,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY growth_rate DESC) AS rn
FROM growth
)
SELECT Category, Entity, growth_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
easy.S17:
SELECT Category, SUM(Measure) AS total_measure
FROM Table
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY total_measure DESC
LIMIT 3;
easy.S18:
SELECT Category, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM Table
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY record_count DESC
LIMIT 3;
easy.S19: WITH category_q3 AS ( SELECT category_column AS Category, MIN(measure_column) AS q3 FROM ( SELECT category_column, measure_column, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_column ORDER BY measure_column) AS pr FROM source_table ) ranked WHERE pr >= 0.75 GROUP BY category_column ) SELECT t.category_column, t.entity_column, t.measure_column, t.other_columns FROM source_table t JOIN category_q3 q ON t.category_column = q.Category WHERE t.measure_column > q.q3;
easy.S20:
WITH yearly_avg AS (
SELECT Category, Year, AVG(Measure) AS avg_measure
FROM Table
GROUP BY Category, Year
),
above_avg AS (
SELECT t.Category, t.Entity, t.Year, t.Measure,
   CASE WHEN t.Measure > ya.avg_measure THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above
FROM Table t
JOIN yearly_avg ya ON t.Category = ya.Category AND t.Year = ya.Year
),
consecutive AS (
SELECT Category, Entity, Year, above,
   LAG(above) OVER (PARTITION BY Category, Entity ORDER BY Year) AS prev_above
FROM above_avg
)
SELECT DISTINCT Category, Entity
FROM consecutive
WHERE above = 1 AND prev_above = 1;

mid.H1: SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL}, COUNT(DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY}) AS entity_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, REL_ENTITY]} GROUP BY {ID_EXTERNAL} HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY}) > 1 ORDER BY entity_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
mid.H2: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, REL_ENTITY]} WHERE {TIME_EVENT} >= :start_a AND {TIME_EVENT} < :end_a), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT {REL_ENTITY} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, REL_ENTITY]} WHERE {TIME_EVENT} >= :start_b AND {TIME_EVENT} < :end_b) SELECT COUNT(*) AS retained_entity_cnt FROM a JOIN b USING ({REL_ENTITY});
mid.H3: SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC}, SUM(CASE WHEN {TIME_EVENT} >= :curr_start AND {TIME_EVENT} < :curr_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN {TIME_EVENT} >= :prev_start AND {TIME_EVENT} < :prev_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, (SUM(CASE WHEN {TIME_EVENT} >= :curr_start AND {TIME_EVENT} < :curr_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SUM(CASE WHEN {TIME_EVENT} >= :prev_start AND {TIME_EVENT} < :prev_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS delta_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, CATEGORY_TOPIC, ID_EXTERNAL]} GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC} ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
mid.H4: WITH agg AS ( SELECT {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS topic, SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) AS amt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, CATEGORY_TOPIC, VAL_AMOUNT]} WHERE {TIME_EVENT} >= :start_time AND {TIME_EVENT} < :end_time GROUP BY {CATEGORY_TOPIC}), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;
mid.H6: WITH daily AS (SELECT DATE( {TIME_EVENT}) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[TIME_EVENT, ID_EXTERNAL]} WHERE {TIME_EVENT} >= :start_time AND {TIME_EVENT} < :end_time GROUP BY d), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt >  prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC LIMIT 3;
mid.H7: SELECT {REL_ENTITY}, SUM(CASE WHEN {STATUS_WORK} = :status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN {STATUS_WORK} = :status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::double precision / COUNT(*) AS hit_ratio FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[STATUS_WORK, REL_ENTITY, ID_EXTERNAL]} GROUP BY {REL_ENTITY} HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min_cnt ORDER BY hit_ratio DESC LIMIT :k;
mid.H10: SELECT {ID_MAIN}, COUNT(DISTINCT {ID_EXTERNAL}) AS external_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_MAIN, ID_EXTERNAL]} GROUP BY {ID_MAIN} HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT {ID_EXTERNAL}) > :threshold ORDER BY external_cnt DESC LIMIT :k;
mid.S6: SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[DESC_LONG, ID_EXTERNAL]} WHERE {DESC_LONG} ILIKE '%':keyword'%' LIMIT :k;
mid.M1: SELECT {LEVEL}, COUNT(DISTINCT {ID_MAIN}) AS entity_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_MAIN, LEVEL]} GROUP BY {LEVEL} ORDER BY entity_cnt DESC LIMIT :k;
mid.M2: SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL}, {VAL_PERCENT} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, VAL_PERCENT]} WHERE {VAL_PERCENT} >= :min_pct ORDER BY {VAL_PERCENT} DESC LIMIT :k;
mid.M3: SELECT {ID_EXTERNAL}, {TIME_DEADLINE} FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_EXTERNAL, TIME_DEADLINE]} WHERE {TIME_DEADLINE} < :as_of_time ORDER BY {TIME_DEADLINE} ASC LIMIT :k;
mid.M4: SELECT {NAME_PERSON}, COUNT(DISTINCT {ID_MAIN}) AS owned_cnt FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_MAIN, NAME_PERSON]} WHERE {NAME_PERSON} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {NAME_PERSON} ORDER BY owned_cnt DESC LIMIT :k;
mid.M5: SELECT SUM({VAL_AMOUNT} * {VAL_PERCENT} / 100.0) AS weighted_amount, SUM({VAL_AMOUNT}) AS total_amount FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[VAL_AMOUNT, VAL_PERCENT]} WHERE {VAL_AMOUNT} IS NOT NULL AND {VAL_PERCENT} IS NOT NULL;
mid.M9:
WITH ev AS (
SELECT {ID_MAIN} AS eid, {CATEGORY_TOPIC} AS topic, {TIME_EVENT} AS ts
FROM {EVENT_SCOPE[ID_MAIN, TIME_EVENT, CATEGORY_TOPIC]}
WHERE {TIME_EVENT} >= :start_time AND {TIME_EVENT} < :end_time
)
SELECT e1.topic, e1.eid, COUNT(*) AS transition_cnt
FROM ev e1 JOIN ev e2
  ON e1.eid = e2.eid AND e1.topic <> e2.topic AND e2.ts > e1.ts
GROUP BY e1.topic, e1.eid
HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min_transitions
ORDER BY transition_cnt DESC LIMIT :k;
